meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在每次回复前会自动调出之前的相关记忆，并在每轮对话结束后把新的要点存起来。记忆保存在容器指定目录，重启后仍在。
howto.when: 当代理运行在默认 Claude provider 的 Claude Code 模式时，每次对话回合都会自动触发记忆的读取和写入。

say.text: 你还记得我上周提到的生日日期吗？
say.note: Claude 会先翻查旧对话再回答。

say.text: 按我上次说的喜好，推荐一部电影吧。
say.note: 它会结合已存记忆来推荐。

say.text: 接着上次没聊完的话题继续。
say.note: 新会话也能接上旧上下文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant past context before each reply and stores new insights after each turn. Memory is saved to a container-mounted directory and persists across restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the agent runs under Claude Code mode with the default Claude provider; memory read/write happens on every conversation turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the birthday date I mentioned last week?
Recommend a movie based on my last stated preferences.
say_en.note: It uses stored memory for the recommendation.

say_en.text: Let's continue the topic we left off last time.
say_en.note: New sessions can pick up old context.
